status_meaning.tested: CI tests run it, and it ran on the real thing it reads: real public dataset files, or the real protocol library (pylsl, websockets, BrainFlow) in a loopback.
status_meaning.experimental: Code and CI tests on synthetic data exist. It has not run on real recordings or a real device.

kinds.dataset-replay: reads a public dataset and emits NTS streams
kinds.dataset-reader: reads the raw files of a public dataset
kinds.decoder-output: turns the output of any decoder into NTS
kinds.file-reader: reads a recording file format (signal source)

adapters.target: Brain-to-Text '25 (Card et al. 2024, participant T15, attempted speech): phoneme CTC logits
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC0 (Dryad).

adapters.target: BrainFlow boards (OpenBCI Cyton, Ganglion and others) -> LSL, and in-process in fidetype live (BrainFlowSource). CI uses the BrainFlow Synthetic board and a fake board only
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. brainflow is MIT. Real boards untested (roadmap P4-06, needs hardware).

adapters.target: Any CTC decoder: (T, V) logits, probabilities or log-probabilities (.npy / .npz, batches)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. No dependency beyond NumPy.

adapters.target: EDF, EDF+ (continuous) and BDF files (many EEG, EMG and sleep systems)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0; open format, no third-party code. Data: the licence of each file.

adapters.target: emg2qwerty (Meta, wrist sEMG during touch typing, 108 users): key presses per prompt
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: research only, streams carry data.research_only = true.

adapters.target: KT-sEMG (Nokia, forearm sEMG during natural typing): key presses, LDA reference decoder
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY 4.0 (copyright 2021 Nokia).

adapters.target: KT-sEMG recording replayed as live raw-signal LSL streams (fidetype live replay-kt)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY 4.0 (copyright 2021 Nokia). pylsl is MIT.

adapters.target: Lab Streaming Layer: NTS in (LSL inlets -> trust layer) and out (NTS files -> LSL outlets)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. pylsl and liblsl are MIT. No LSL code copied.

adapters.target: Any raw-signal LSL stream and its marker stream (LSLSource of fidetype live; reconnect P4-11)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. pylsl is MIT.

adapters.target: OpenBCI GUI v5+ raw recordings (Cyton, Cyton + Daisy, Ganglion)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0; no OpenBCI code used. Data: the licence of each recording.

adapters.target: SpanishBCBL typing MEG (Brain2Qwerty data): ConvCTC output per typing segment
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY-NC 4.0: research only, streams carry data.research_only = true.

adapters.target: SpanishBCBL typing MEG: file discovery, behavioural logs, clock alignment, typed text
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC BY-NC 4.0 (research only). Brain2Qwerty loader (CC BY-NC): not copied.

adapters.target: Synthetic typist signal with key-press markers (SyntheticSource; no real data)
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Synthetic data, no licence needed.

adapters.target: Any text-only decoder: CSV id,text or JSON Lines n-best lists -> hypothesis stream
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. No dependency beyond the standard library and NumPy.

adapters.target: Toronto sEMG typing dataset (Achituve et al. 2025, forearm sEMG, 19 participants): key presses
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0 (own Intan RHD reader). Data CC BY 4.0. Baseline code CC BY-SA 4.0: not copied.

adapters.target: Willett et al. 2021 handwriting BCI: real-time RNN character output
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. Data CC0. Reads sentences.mat with SciPy (BSD-3-Clause).

adapters.target: WebSocket binding nts-ws/0.1 (FEP-0004): NTS in both directions, decisions out
adapters.licence: Code Apache-2.0. websockets is BSD-3-Clause.

adapters.target: BIDS-EEG datasets (for example OpenNeuro EEG studies) and MOABB-listed BCI datasets
adapters.licence: Per dataset (often CC0 or CC BY 4.0); check each one. MOABB licence not checked.

adapters.target: BrainVision files (.vhdr / .eeg / .vmrk)
adapters.licence: Open format; not checked.

adapters.target: Brain Products amplifiers (LiveAmp, actiCHamp) through their LSL connector
adapters.licence: Not checked (vendor LSL connector). The LSL path itself exists (lsl-signal-source).

adapters.target: Consumer sEMG wristbands (for example Myo-class bands)
adapters.licence: Not checked (vendor protocols; some bands are discontinued).

adapters.target: GDF files (for example BCI Competition IV 2a / 2b)

adapters.target: Public inner / imagined speech EEG datasets (for example 'Thinking out loud', Kara One)

adapters.target: Interaxon Muse 2 / Muse S headband (4-channel EEG)

adapters.target: OpenBCI Cyton / Ganglion on a real board (code exists in brainflow; a real-board test does not)

adapters.target: OPM-MEG systems (wearable MEG)
